_about: Hand-checked labels for the evaluation. Each label has a verbatim quote from the policy; scripts/eval.py refuses to run if a quote isn't found in the policy text. Labels were drafted with an AI coding assistant (not Nemotron) by reading each policy, then checked against the quote. null means the policy doesn't state it clearly, and that field isn't scored for that policy.

free_to_fpl: Patients approved for Financial Assistance with an annual Family Income of 250% of FPL guidelines or less will receive a 100% discount on gross charges
discount_to_fpl: Patients approved for Financial Assistance with an annual Family Income between 251% and 400% of FPL guidelines will receive a discount on gross charges
residency_kind: An individual must be a Resident of Colorado in order to qualify for Financial Assistance.
insured_eligible: The Patient is Uninsured or Under-insured; and
hardship_pct: is greater than 50% of the Patient's total annual Family Income and Financial Resources combined.
window_days: Applicants have the later of (a) 365 days from the date of the first post-discharge Billing
